title: Philadelphia 76ers @ New York Knicks | 開幕戦を見たい理由
description: Philadelphia 76ers @ New York Knicks, Oct 20, 2026 (ET): official 2025–26 records, first possession watchpoints, and factual head-to-head context. 検証済みの勝率予測モデルなし.

sections.heading: この対戦を見る理由
paragraphs: Philadelphia returns to New York after being swept 4–0 in the 2026 East semifinal; the defending champion Knicks now face a changed Sixers lineup.

sections.heading: 2025–26年の戦力データ
paragraphs: Last completed regular season: PHI 45–37, NYK 53–29; points scored per game 115.9 vs 116.5, points allowed 116.1 vs 110.1. Last-season records are not current-season forecasts.

sections.heading: 最近の調子と直近5試合
paragraphs: The five dated scores below are official NBA head-to-head results. Previous regular-season final-ten form: PHI 6–4, NYK 6–4; not 2026 preseason games.

sections.heading: 参考勝率とその限界
paragraphs: The displayed PHI 40.0% / NYK 60.0% values are a transparent but uncalibrated baseline using last season's wins alone. It omits current lineups, injuries, home-court adjustment and all roster changes. Not betting odds.
bullets: Model: p(home) = (home historical win% × away historical loss%) / [(home win% × away loss%) + (away win% × home loss%)]
